about_the_game:
1. Minimalist visuals with strategic gameplay

  • Hand-drawn style: Soft and cozy visuals create a unique atmosphere.

  • Intuitive controls: Tap near the bubble to generate a gentle push and control its direction.

  • Limited taps: Each level restricts the number of taps, so you must plan your moves carefully.

2. Hazards and interactive elements

  • Environmental threats: Stove flames or a sparking hairdryer can instantly burst your bubble.

  • Dynamic obstacles: Time your moves to cleverly avoid playful animals.

  • Unexpected aids: A fan in the room might give you a helpful boost.

  • More challenges: Navigate through bathroom steam, dodge kitchen fires and knife racks—each area presents unique physics-based obstacles.

3. A relaxing yet challenging experience

  • Casual play: Respawn without limits and take your time planning the best route.

  • Progressive difficulty: Simple mechanics combined with clever level design—later stages demand precise control and creative solutions.

  • Stage achievements: Clearing levels unlocks a variety of quirky achievements.

short_description: It‘s a beautifully minimalist and fun-filled puzzle adventure. You guide a delicate bubble through the hidden dangers of everyday life. By clicking the mouse to create gentle air currents, you must lead the bubble across rooms filled with unique traps—before it bursts or your limited taps run out.
